description: XSS allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by other users.
misconfigurations: Reflecting user input without HTML encoding
Improper use of dangerouslySetInnerHTML in React
real_world_incidents: Samy worm on MySpace, which propagated via a Stored XSS vulnerability.
recommended_actions: Use HttpOnly flags for session cookies.

audience_guidance.student: XSS lets hackers run malicious JavaScript in another user's browser, stealing their session.
audience_guidance.developer: Always encode user input before rendering it in the browser. Rely on modern frameworks (React, Angular) that escape by default.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Inject payloads like <script>alert(1)</script> or javascript: URLs in all input fields and URL parameters.
audience_guidance.pentester: Demonstrate impact by stealing cookies or exploiting administrative functionalities via the victim's session.
audience_guidance.security_team: Enforce strong CSP headers and utilize automated DAST tools to catch reflected input.
